about: Raderna i "Blades was updated"-popupen: en post per EAS Update, nyast först, id +1 varje gång. Bara den uppdateringens egna ändringar, på engelska, med New:, Improved: eller Fixed: som App Store-texten och det viktigaste först. Se services/updateNotes.ts och scripts/publish-update.mjs.

notes: New: Promo codes can now give Blades Max or 500 Blade coins. Redeem them under Promo code in Blades Premium.
Improved: Block import times are one field again. Nothing is selected when you tap, and the cross clears the field.
Improved: Block import times are clearer, with separate hours and minutes you can change without selecting the whole time.
New: Simulator time from your logbook asks right away which simulator type it was, and you can split it between types.
Fixed: Text in the Logbook header could look blurred or cut off after using the logbook camera.
New: Block import can use a photo from your camera roll. Choose it when you add a photo, also for year by year.
New: Block import starts from a photo of your latest logbook page. Blades reads your totals and the aircraft on it.
New: Year by year: photograph each spread where a new year starts, and Blades works out your hours for each year.
Improved: Values read from the photo are marked, and anything that doesn't add up is shown in yellow to check.
New: Block import manually is redesigned. Enter your total first, add only the details you need and see if the parts add up.
New: Give your past hours to each aircraft or drone and see how much is left to give out.
New: Past simulator time per simulator type, and military drone categories such as MRPAS, RPAS and NATO classes.
Fixed: Registrations saved twice, once with a zero and once with the letter O, are now one aircraft. You can undo it under Edit flights, Recent changes.
New: Import checks registrations for a zero where your logbook has the letter O, or the other way round, and saves them the way your logbook writes them.
Fixed: Transcribe in your digital logbook now opens the spread you are looking at.
Improved: Registrations in Log flight are listed in order, by letters and then number.
Improved: The horizontal workload bar is gone from the dashboard. The ring shows the same value.
New: Weather on the dashboard is now one card: flight category, wind, visibility, cloud and QNH, plus the next change in the forecast. Pull down to fetch it, tap it for the full METAR and TAF.
Improved: Updates now download quietly in the background. No download banner and no restart prompt, only this note once the update is in.
Improved: On the dashboard, earlier flights now show their date on the left of the card.
Improved: When a page total doesn't add up, the check asks about the cell that looks misread and suggests the value that makes the column add up. It no longer offers to adjust several flights.
Improved: The full screen check shows how sure each colour is in percent: Positive, Uncertain and Very unsure.
Fixed: In the full screen check, tapping a cell now opens that cell. Before, cells left of the arrival time all opened the date.
Fixed: The full screen check stays sideways when you turn the phone upright.
Fixed: What the app read lines up with the page as before. The latest column adjustment made it worse and is removed.
Improved: What the app read now lines up better with each column on the page, such as landings and remarks.
Improved: In full-screen scan review, the cell you pick shows your own handwriting, on the page and beside the field.
Improved: The eye is already on when you open full-screen scan review.
New: Check a scanned spread in full screen. The eye colours what the app read by how sure it is, and you tap a cell to fix it.
Improved: The eye in the scan review also shows the page totals the app read.
New: Enlarge any requirement chart in Next licence with the magnifying glass, and tap again to shrink it back.
Improved: Logbook scan asks about every registration that is new to your Fleet before it is accepted.
New: The scan report lists the registrations, new ones first, with an example flight and a way to change them.
Improved: The Edit flights button in the Logbook header matches the view switcher and its icon is centred.
New: Edit flights is a pencil button in the Logbook header and starts with the column you want to fix.
New: Change aircraft, airport codes, take-offs, landings and remarks on many flights, or delete flights, with undo.
Improved: Add media on the flight card is a round icon beside the share button.
Improved: A shared flight asks about the aircraft type and registration separately, with similar ones from your Fleet.
Improved: You can add an aircraft type or registration you don't have yet straight from a shared flight.
Improved: Log flight only shows a note for a shared flight when you already have it in your logbook.
Fixed: The second pilot list in Log flight is no longer covered by the cabin crew row.
Improved: A shared flight now opens straight in Log flight, filled in and ready to check.
Improved: A shared flight link comes with a line that says which flight it is and who sent it.
Improved: The scan camera has narrower side panels, so the frame for the logbook is larger.
Improved: The side panels are see-through, so you can see the camera image behind them.
Fixed: The scan camera opens in landscape right away, without first showing a squeezed upright screen.
Fixed: The dashboard is no longer stretched sideways after you close the scan camera.
Fixed: The app no longer stays in landscape after you close the scan camera.
Fixed: The scan camera opens faster, without the long black screen.
Improved: The logbook scan camera has a new look, with the instructions on the left and the shutter on the right.
Improved: Three checks show what the camera is waiting for before it takes the photo.
Improved: The camera turns to landscape by itself when you start scanning.
Fixed: Take-offs and landings now follow a shared flight into Log flight.
Fixed: The crew line in the remarks is kept when you open a shared flight.
New: Share a flight with your second pilot from the flight card on the dashboard.
New: A shared flight opens in Log flight with your roles swapped. Check it, then save.
New: Open a shared flight file under Settings, Import.
Improved: The logbook choices in Settings are shorter and easier to read.
Improved: Settings shows which logbook and layout you use, and switching is one clear step.
Improved: Take the Blades introduction is now a clear button in Settings.
Fixed: The globe and the maps open again without an error.
Fixed: Editing a flight keeps its flight rules and IFR time, and shows your changes right away.
New: A short Saved flight note lists what changed, with plus or minus time per category.
Improved: Edit many flights shows total and night time for each flight before you save.
Improved: Tap a flight in the preview to leave it out of the change.
New: Edit many flights at once from your logbook list, and see before and after first.
New: Check your data finds flights that look wrong, like night flights with no NVG time.
New: Every change to many flights can be undone, in pilot and drone mode.
Fixed: The digital logbook opens again. It showed an error screen after the last update.
Fixed: A second logbook now starts on the page and row you set, and the one before it ends on its last page.
New: Adding another logbook uses the guided setup and asks if it looks like your last one.
Improved: Modify logbook is an overview with a live preview of the page, in drone mode too.
New: Pilot CV has four designs and seven colour themes to choose from.
New: Add education, skills, references and more, and get a profile text suggested from your logbook.
Improved: Your CV details are filled in one part at a time, each with its own on and off switch.
Fixed: Pop-ups now wait while Global map or Visited airports is open, which could lock the screen.
Improved: The fleet pop-up waits until the Blades introduction has finished.
Fixed: The last step of the onboarding preview opens the real scan and import pages.
New: Export to PDF builds your pilot CV, with your totals and pages from your digital logbook.
New: Choose the content, colours and typeface, and see the preview change as you edit.
Improved: The onboarding page for pilots with a digital logbook now mentions scanning your paper pages.
Improved: Military drone pilots see NATO classes on the onboarding page, hobby pilots A1 to A3.
Fixed: The headline on that page is no longer cut off.
Improved: The onboarding page for pilots with a digital logbook shows clearer benefits.
Fixed: The picture on that page no longer overlaps the progress bar.
Improved: A bolder onboarding page shows what Blades does with your logbook, for paper, digital and drone pilots.
Improved: Onboarding asks all its questions on one page and shows the whole answer on the next.
Improved: The "Setting up your logbook" page is gone.
Improved: The price comparison in onboarding shows what you save each month and in a year.
Improved: The onboarding pages that show what Blades does for you are cleaner, with less text.
Improved: The price question and comparison in onboarding are now per month.
New: Onboarding asks what matters to you and where your hours are today, then shows what Blades does for you.
New: See the time and cost of scanning a whole paper logbook, in your own currency.
Improved: The last onboarding step suggests one way to bring in your hours.
Improved: The tour's example fills in departure place and time first, then arrival place and time.
New: The tour shows the scan button's options, and an example logbook if you have none.
Improved: The tour's example flight is half day, half night, logged as SIC with the captain as PIC.
Improved: The tour card with pause and arrows is smaller.
New: The Blades introduction plays by itself in about 90 seconds, with pause, back and next.
Improved: The tour now shows Insights and lights up what each stop is about.
Fixed: The example flight in the tour is no longer saved to your logbook.
Improved: Clear solid column lines in every digital logbook.
Improved: Use the number from your paper book right in the logbook setup.
Improved: Backfill missing hours follows the numbers you set there.
Fixed: The Longest XC distance in Insights is no longer cut off at the top.
New: Variants like EC135T1 and EC135T2 share a family page in Fleet.
Improved: Scans keep variants apart and ask before merging them.
New: A new aircraft in a family can be added as a variant or merged.
Improved: Changing an aircraft type in a scan offers to change the other flights too.
Improved: The empty logbook offers Scan your logbook as a fourth way in.
Fixed: Blade coins running low is shown in gold on the whole line.
Improved: The trial week is offered only during onboarding.
Improved: The trial button shows what you pay after the trial week.
New: A shorter onboarding that matches the rest of the app.
New: Preview it from Settings without changing your logbook.
Improved: A shorter Remove button in the flight album photo viewer.
Fixed: The Best week replay shows your helicopter on rest days, not a plane.
Improved: Best week replays from above in one still view of the whole week.
Improved: Next licence list charts each have their own timeline with readable years.
Improved: The Insights previews look the same on every plan.
Improved: Projections, Next licence, Longest XC and Best week in Insights are part of Premium and Max.
New: Insights has four clean previews for Projections, Next licence, Longest XC and Best week. Tap one to open it.
New: Next licence in full screen switches between chart and list, with a small chart for each requirement.
Improved: Syncing photos again only looks at flights added since your last sync, and is much faster.
Improved: A flight with a single photo or video now gets it as its cover automatically.
Fixed: The photo carousel on the dashboard now shows your flight album right after a sync.
Improved: Flight covers are picked from your photos first, not videos.
Improved: Flight album photos now count up to 15 minutes before take-off and after landing, and you can choose 10, 5 or none.
New: Photo sync adds all your flight photos at once. Choose how long before take-off and after landing they count.
New: Redesigned flight album with one card per flight, photos by phase, and easy removing.
Improved: The Blade coins row in Settings is tighter, with a smaller + button.
Improved: Blade coins in Settings now sit right on the background, without a card.
Improved: Logbook scan only lets you pick as many spreads as your coins cover.
Improved: The spreads your coins cover are always read to the end, even if they cost a little more.
Improved: Logbook scanning now uses the same coin rate for everyone, about 30 coins a spread.
Fixed: Upgrade to Max on your profile now opens the upgrade screen instead of just closing the profile.
Improved: Blade coins in Settings got a new look: a ring around the coin shows monthly (gold) and bought (cyan) coins.
New: Tap the coins row to see what is left of each kind, buy more or read how coins work.
Improved: Drone Log Flight now moves you on like pilot mode: place, take-off time, then your flight time.
Improved: In A to B the next box opens by itself: departure, departure time, arrival, arrival time.
New: Repeat latest flight at the top of drone Log Flight fills in the place, drone and crew from last time.
Improved: The place is no longer filled in for you, and the place and time boxes are the same size.
Improved: In drone Log Flight the flight time box is bigger and lights up so you see where to type.
Improved: Take-off time is no longer filled in with the current time.
Improved: Drone flights from A to B use airport codes, just like pilot mode.
Improved: The drone logbook shows where each flight was, like the pilot logbook.
Fixed: Cabin crew is dimmed together with Second pilot when you choose Solo.
New: Drone Log Flight has a new design with Quicklog and Full, and Same spot or A to B like pilot mode.
New: Pick the drone category for each flight, civil or military, and choose if the drone keeps it.
Improved: Swipe down to close Profile, like the other settings pages.
Improved: Sun route tells you when night falls and what goes in your logbook, also in the flight overview.
New: For flights that start and end at the same place, pick the direction you flew on a compass over the map.
New: A Solo button in Log Flight sets PIC, pilot flying and single pilot in one tap and logs the flight as solo.
Fixed: The column lines in the EASA AMC1 FCL.050 logbook now match the printed book.
New: See your digital logbook open and leaf through its pages before you set it up.
Improved: Set the first page with flights for your earlier logbooks, after the book's intro pages.
New: A guided set-up for your digital logbook that checks your totals against your paper book and helps you fix any difference.
Improved: Imports and logbook scans set pilot flying for you, and empty columns no longer end up in your remarks.
New: Imports and logbook scans spot flights already in your logbook and leave them out, so nothing is counted twice.
New: Flights that overlap another flight in your logbook are flagged, and you choose which one to keep.
Fixed: Identical flights on the same day, like two circuits, are now all saved.
New: Tap a highlighted point in the import report to jump to the flights it means.
New: Leave out single flights from an import before you save.
Fixed: Flight time in the import report no longer includes simulator time, which is shown on its own.
Improved: A cleaner import report, with the AI tags gone and notes as a tidy list.
Fixed: Recent dates are no longer flagged as being in the future.
Improved: A clearer import report, with everything to check in one place.
New: Hours bank in drone Insights, like in pilot mode.
Improved: Support in Settings opens the help page with FAQ and contact form.
Improved: Edit a flight straight from the top of its page.
Improved: Stressfactor is simpler, with your zone right now on top and a clearer chart.
New: Step back through months, quarters and years in Stressfactor.
Fixed: Airport labels on the Longest XC and Best week maps sit on the route.
Improved: The Best week replay flies straight legs, like Longest XC.
Fixed: Manage subscription on your profile opens again.
Improved: Upgrade straight from Settings, with the button right under Profile.
Improved: Your profile has a new look, and you manage your subscription there.
New: Logbook scan shows about how many spreads your Blade coins cover.
Improved: Your subscription and Blade coins have a simpler look in Settings, with one bar for monthly and extra coins.
New: Manage your subscription from the new Subscription row under Profile.
Improved: Logbook scans in the test app use Blade coins, like the App Store version. Buy more in the sandbox.
New: Blades Max, with 500 Blade coins every month, next to Premium on the same paywall.
New: Buy more Blade coins in packs of 100, 250 or 500. Coins you buy never expire.
Fixed: In Next licence full screen you can see the year each licence was completed.
Fixed: Projections and Next licence turn to landscape as soon as you open them in full screen.
Improved: Best week follows each trip at its own zoom, so short and long trips are both easy to follow.
Fixed: The aircraft points the right way and stays in the middle of the map, above a smaller panel.
New: Satellite and zoom in the Best week map.
Improved: The Longest XC replay adapts to the distance, so long flights are easy to follow.
Improved: Long legs follow the great-circle route, like a real flight.
New: Switch the Longest XC map to satellite, and zoom in or out while it plays.
Improved: The Longest XC replay is slower, so you can follow every leg.
Improved: Cleaner map previews in Best week and Longest XC.
New: Best week and Longest XC maps replay like a film, with a camera that follows your flights.
New: Open Projections and Next licence in landscape full screen with the button next to the title.
New: Touch and drag the chart to read any month, and see your licence date at your best, usual or slowest pace.
Fixed: FAA requirements in Next licence now follow Part 61, with separate ATP requirements for helicopters.
Improved: FAA cross-country time counts flights that land more than 50 NM away, or 25 NM in a helicopter.
Improved: FAA instrument currency uses calendar months and counts all training devices.
Fixed: Next licence follows the EASA rules more closely. PPL(A) has no night requirement, and ATPL(H) needs 350 h multi-pilot.
Improved: Simulator time now counts towards your licence where EASA allows it, up to the limits.
Improved: ATPL PIC now counts PICUS, and ATPL night counts only as PIC or co-pilot.
New: Replay your best week on the map, flight by flight.
Improved: Best week and Longest XC maps are cleaner, with airport codes in cyan.
Fixed: Flights on a Monday now count towards their own week.
New: Best week and Longest XC have a new look with your flights on the map. Tap the map to replay the week or the whole flight.
Improved: Projections and Next licence have calmer colours, a taller chart and smaller buttons.
New: Next licence has a new look. See how ready you are, which requirement sets the date and every licence you've completed, as a chart or a list.
Improved: Experience & projections is now simply called Projections.
New: Experience & projections has a new look. Drag your target on the chart, try another pace and follow your goals.
New: Custom CSV export for your drone logbook, and drone CSV import now works like the pilot import.
Fixed: Sharing an export no longer risks freezing the app.
Fixed: Scanning never accepts a time that doesn't exist, like 07:80, and suggests real times instead.
Fixed: The maps no longer stop responding after you open an airport's weather.
Fixed: The globe on the dashboard comes back by itself if it stops moving.
Improved: This message now only shows what's new since your last update.
